title: 第15章 你算老几第16章 亲传弟子
slug: 你一个武夫谁让你炼剑的
lines: 众人全都惊愕的看向地上还在微微抽搐的血红色妖狼。
竟是一只三阶血狼王！
这到底是什么情况，所有人都不明白刚才发生了什么，而且没想到灌木林中还潜伏着一只三阶血狼王。
这时，先前那二十多只妖狼在看到自己的王死后，一边逃跑一边扭头哀嚎。
秦关从远处的灌木林中走了出来。
众人看向秦关，眼神复杂又心惊，显然，这只三阶血狼王是秦关杀的。
三阶血狼王，实力无限接近玄通境修士，竟然被秦关在一瞬间一击毙命，这强的有点过分啊？
他的实力应该是无限接近四境武夫了吧？
秦关身上没有武夫罡气，因为只有四境开了气门的武夫才会有罡气，众人皆是在心中猜测着。
秦关走到血狼王身边将它提了起来，随后来到南柔身边笑道：
“这狼的皮毛不错，收起来，等回去做一件红色大氅一定很好看。”
“嗯！”回过神的南柔急忙点头，然后将血狼王收进了储物袋。
一只血狼王市场上可是能卖到十多万金的，光是肉一般人都吃不到，众人看到南柔将血狼王收进储物袋后羡慕的不得了。
“哈哈，不愧是老夫的好女婿啊，三阶血狼王都能轻易击杀！”
南云起满脸欢笑，他转头看向众人，沉声道：“待会全都听秦关和柔儿的，谁若是再有异议回家去！”
他这话明显是说给杨红梅和南乔听的，此刻二人也只能默默忍着不说话，毕竟秦关实力摆在那里，接近四境的武夫放眼整个鹿云城都没几个对手。
“走吧，狼群的领地范围很广，前面应该没什么危险了。”
秦关说完带着南柔朝前方走去。
见识到秦关轻松杀死血狼王，众人全都跟在他后面，走起路来不再蹑手蹑脚，感觉特别有安全感。
此刻他们突然觉得武夫也没有传说中那么不堪，尤其是有了陈广灵和南云起的对比，他们倒觉得武夫比修士明显要强不少。
一个时辰后，一行人停在了一片非常空旷广阔的区域，四面群山环绕，像是一个巨大盆地。
当踏入这片区域后，众人皆是眼神一亮有些激动，因为此刻他们明显能感觉到这地方灵气波动的很厉害，而且很浓郁！
“大小姐，您真是神了，隔着那么远的距离都能感受到这边灵气波动！”
甲全看向南柔，无比佩服道。
“是啊，大小姐您这也太牛了！”
很多弟子也纷纷点头，开始他们还都是半信半疑，觉得有些儿戏，此刻自己能切身感受到灵气波动后，全都对南柔佩服不已。
这地方四面环山极为隐蔽，要不是南柔凭借敏锐的感知力，还真难找到。
“这病秧子该不会是什么特殊体质吧，隔着那么远的距离都能找过来！”
杨红梅看了眼南柔忍不住在心中嘀咕道。
南乔也是有些不敢相信，想到之前自己还不停地嘲笑南柔，不禁觉得脸颊像是被人狠狠的扇了两巴掌，火辣辣的疼。
被众人这么一夸，从来没想过自己有一天也能成为家族有用的人后，南柔心里高兴坏了，她急忙指着远处一棵参天大树说道：
content_en:
Everyone looked at the blood-red demon wolf on the ground, still twitching slightly, in shock.
It was actually a third-level blood wolf king!
What exactly is going on? No one understands what just happened, and they didn't expect that there is a third-level blood wolf king lurking in the bushes.
"Ouch!"
At this time, the more than 20 demon wolves from earlier turned their heads and howled while running away when they saw their king dead.
Qin Guan walked out of the bushes in the distance.
Everyone looked at Qin Guan with complex and frightened eyes. It was obvious that Qin Guan had killed this third-level blood wolf king.
The third-level blood wolf king, whose strength was infinitely close to that of a Xuan Tong realm monk, was killed by Qin Guan in an instant. Isn't this a bit too strong?
His strength should be infinitely close to that of a Four Realm martial artist, right?
There is no martial arts Qi in Qing Guan, because only warriors who have opened their Qi in the four realms can have Qi. Everyone is guessing in their hearts.
Qin Guan walked to the Blood Wolf King and picked it up, then came to Nanrou and smiled:
"This wolf's fur is nice. Put it away and make a red cloak when you go back. It will look great."
"Yeah!" Nanrou nodded quickly after coming back to her senses, and then put the Blood Wolf King into the storage bag.
A blood wolf king can be sold for more than 100,000 gold in the market. Most people can't eat the meat alone. Everyone was extremely envious after seeing Nanrou put the blood wolf king into the storage bag.
"Haha, you are indeed my good son-in-law. He can easily kill the third-level blood wolf king!"
Nan Yunqi's face was full of laughter. He turned to look at everyone and said in a deep voice: "Everyone will listen to Qin Guan and Rou'er later. If anyone has any objections, go home!"
His words were obviously meant for Yang Hongmei and Nan Qiao. At this moment, the two could only endure silence. After all, the strength of Qin Guan was there, and the martial artist who was close to the fourth realm had few opponents in the entire Luyun City.
"Let's go. The wolf pack's territory is very wide. There should be no danger ahead."
After Qin Guan finished speaking, he took Nanrou and walked forward.
Seeing Qin Guan kill the Blood Wolf King easily, everyone followed him and no longer tiptoed when walking, feeling particularly safe.
At this moment, they suddenly felt that the martial artist was not as unbearable as the legend said. Especially with the comparison between Chen Guangling and Nan Yunqi, they felt that the martial artist was obviously much stronger than the monk.
An hour later, the group stopped in a very empty and vast area, surrounded by mountains on all sides, like a huge basin.
When they stepped into this area, everyone's eyes lit up and they were a little excited, because at this moment they could clearly feel that the spiritual energy in this place was fluctuating very strongly, and it was very strong!
"Miss, you are really amazing. You can feel the fluctuations of spiritual energy here from such a long distance!"
Jia Quan looked at Nan Rou and said with great admiration.
"Yes, Miss, you are so awesome!"
Many disciples also nodded. At first, they were all dubious and thought it was a bit childish. Now that they could feel the fluctuations of spiritual energy, they all admired Nan Rou.
This place is extremely hidden surrounded by mountains. If Nanrou hadn't relied on her keen perception, it would have been difficult to find it.
"Does this sick man have a special constitution? He can be found even from such a long distance!"
Yang Hongmei glanced at Nan Rou and couldn't help but mutter in her heart.
Nan Qiao also couldn't believe it. Thinking that he kept laughing at Nan Rou before, he couldn't help but feel as if his cheek had been slapped hard twice, and it hurt.
